evals.prompt: Review this AntD form email field. It renders `` followed by `{msg}` for the message. The input has no `aria-invalid` and no `aria-describedby`, and the error is not the a11y `FieldError` component.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C2 — wrong/hand-rolled field-error component in an AntD form and missing aria wiring.
evals.expected_output: C2 (Correct field-error component chosen and wired) FAILs: this AntD-form field uses a hand-rolled `<span className="err">` instead of the a11y `FieldError` component, and the input is missing `aria-invalid` plus an `aria-describedby` pointing at the error's `id`. Fix: render `<FieldError id="email-err" message={msg} />` and set `aria-invalid={!!msg}` + `aria-describedby="email-err"` on the Input. Overall verdict: NEEDS FIX.

evals.prompt: Review this responsive table. It swaps a table for a card list on mobile via `const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 600px)');`, and its toolbar styling uses `@media (max-width: 768px) { .toolbar { gap: 8px; } }`.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C3 — ad-hoc breakpoint for a shape switch + wrong media-query value (768px not 767.98px).
evals.expected_output: C3 (Responsive shape switches use useIsMobile(); pure styling uses the media query) FAILs: the table->card-list shape switch is gated on an ad-hoc `useMediaQuery('(max-width: 600px)')` instead of `useIsMobile()`, and the pure-styling media query uses `768px` instead of the canonical `767.98px` (which avoids the sub-pixel gap at fractional DPR). Fix: gate the shape switch on `useIsMobile()` and change the media query to `@media (max-width: 767.98px)`. Overall verdict: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Overall verdict is NEEDS FIX
C3 is marked FAIL
Evidence cites the ad-hoc useMediaQuery breakpoint and the 768px media query
Fix says use useIsMobile() and @media (max-width: 767.98px)

evals.prompt: Self-check this respondent quiz screen. Announcements use `<LiveRegion message={announcement} />` (always mounted); progress uses `<Progressbar value={n} min={0} max={total} label={t('quiz.progress')} />`; the inline field error uses `<FieldErrorDisplay id="q3-err" messageKey={error} />` with the input carrying `aria-invalid={!!error}` and `aria-describedby="q3-err"`; the mobile layout swap is gated on `useIsMobile()` while toolbar styling uses `@media (max-width: 767.98px)`; the loading placeholder is a layout-mirroring skeleton with `role="status"` + `aria-busy`; and all visible text is wrapped in AntD `Typography`.
evals.label: good-control
evals.notes: Good control (respondent context) — all primitives reused, correct FieldErrorDisplay, canonical breakpoint, a11y contracts intact.
evals.expected_output: All 4 criteria PASS. C1: LiveRegion, Progressbar, FieldErrorDisplay, and a layout-mirroring skeleton are all canonical registry primitives, nothing hand-rolled. C2: FieldErrorDisplay is the correct choice for a respondent renderer, with aria-invalid + aria-describedby wired to its id. C3: shape switch on useIsMobile(), styling at the canonical 767.98px. C4: LiveRegion stays mounted (assertive+atomic, no role=alert), Progressbar carries role/aria-value*/aria-label, skeleton has role=status+aria-busy, text in Typography. Overall verdict: OK TO SHIP.
assertions: Overall verdict is OK TO SHIP
All of C1 through C4 are marked PASS
C2 confirms FieldErrorDisplay is correct for a respondent renderer with aria wiring
C4 confirms LiveRegion stays mounted, assertive+atomic, no role=alert
